summary: Google Cloud's AI startup program grants up to $350,000 in Google Cloud credits over two years for eligible AI-first, VC-funded startups (Grow/Scale tier). Year 1 is 100% up to $100,000 generally, or 100% up to $250,000 for AI-first startups; Year 2 covers only 20% of usage up to an additional $100,000 in credits. The company pays all uncovered or excess charges, including the uncovered share in Year 2; Google need not notify it when credits are exhausted. Credits may be issued incrementally at Google's discretion. Coupon redemption deadlines are communicated in writing; credit-expiry dates are specified in writing at issuance or shown in the console/dashboard. Credits cover Google models such as Gemini and Gemma; third-party models are billed directly and are not covered. Eligibility is selection-based: Pre-Seed/Seed within the last five years or Series A within the last 12 months, founded within five years, not yet received more than $5,000 in Google Cloud credits, and at Google Cloud's discretion. The AI program also requires using or planning to use Gemini to deploy AI services as a foundation of the primary product or solution. This is distinct from the $300 Free Trial listing.
claim_steps: Confirm eligibility: VC-funded startup using or planning to use Gemini as a foundation of its primary product/solution; Pre-Seed/Seed raised within five years or Series A within 12 months, founded within five years, and no more than $5,000 prior Google Cloud credits.
Apply at cloud.google.com/startup/ai (selection-based; acceptance is at Google Cloud's discretion).
If accepted, use program credits on Google Cloud services and Google models (Gemini/Gemma). Third-party models are not covered.
Year 2 covers only 20% of usage up to an additional $100,000 in credits. Your company pays all uncovered or excess charges, including the uncovered Year 2 share.
Credits may be issued incrementally at Google's discretion. Follow written coupon-redemption deadlines and check credit-expiry dates in the written award or console/dashboard.
Monitor usage and credit balances: Google is not required to notify you when credits are exhausted. Stop unwanted billable usage to avoid ongoing costs.
Do not confuse this with the separate $300 Google Cloud Free Trial.
